name: pangram-ai-detector
title: Pangram AI Detector
description: Check selected or copied text for AI writing with your Pangram API key and prepaid credits.
author: mygirleatsmayo

commands.name: check-selected-text
commands.title: Check Selected Text
commands.description: Check the selected text for AI writing.

commands.name: check-clipboard-text
commands.title: Check Clipboard Text
commands.description: Check the clipboard text for AI writing.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Get your key and add prepaid credits at pangram.com/apikey. Each new Check costs about $0.05 per started 100 words.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Choose the Model for new Checks. Default uses Pangram's current Model.

preferences.name: versionInvalidatesCache
preferences.title: Cache
preferences.label: Invalidate older Cached Results
preferences.description: Ignore older Cached Results after detecting a new Model Version. Reusing a Cached Result costs no credits.

preferences.name: literalSegmentText
preferences.title: Segments
preferences.label: Show Segment text literally
preferences.description: Show Pangram's Segment text exactly as returned, in a code block. Turn off to render it as Markdown.

preferences.name: confirmAboveWords
preferences.title: Confirm Above (Words)
preferences.description: Ask before sending texts above this estimated word count. Default: 2000.

preferences.name: limitedConfidenceBelowWords
preferences.title: Limited Confidence Below (Words)
preferences.description: Show the extension's Limited Confidence warning below this word count. Separate from Pangram's Segment confidence. Default: 200.

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Timeout (Seconds)
preferences.description: Time to wait for a Check to finish. Default: 300 seconds.
